title: The frontmatter of a task file (work/tasks/T-NNNN-short-name.md)
description: Checked by `node scripts/task.mjs lint`, which reads the keywords used here and refuses any other.

step.description: The step of the RFC the task delivers, or the empty string.

rfc.description: The number of the RFC the task belongs to, or the empty string.

writes.description: The paths only this task may change while it is held.

appends.description: The shared files it may make small additive edits to.

checks.description: The commands that pass before the task is submitted, run from the repository's root. `yarn platform:check`, `yarn platform:test` and `yarn prettier:check` run on what the task changed, and `yarn lint:repo` as far as its parts take files; `AEP_WHOLE_TREE=1` before one runs it on the whole tree (work/README.md). A task of kind build or fix needs at least one: its claim and its submit are refused without (the lint is not).

claim.description: Null unless the task is in progress.

review.description: The review mark: who reviews the task in review, since when, and its last beat. Absent or null unless the task is in review and a reviewer ran `task review`.

path.description: A file, or a directory ending in `/`, from the repository's root. No wildcard.

worker.description: The tool and the model, never a person's name or email address.
